key_big: Subtracting a negative is the same as adding
key_sub: On the number line, numbers increase to the right: −7 < −3 < 0 < 2.
body_html:
How it works

Numbers less than zero are negative: floors below ground, temperatures below 0°C, a debt. Together with 0 and the positive whole numbers they are the integers.

On the number line, the number further right is greater, so −3 > −7.

Adding a negative moves left: 5 + (−8) = −3. Subtracting a negative moves right: 2 − (−6) = 8. Brahmagupta wrote rules like these in 628 CE.

Example

Work out −4 + 9.

Start at −4, move 9 right

Answer: 5

Example

Work out 3 − (−5).

Subtracting −5 is adding 5

Answer: 8

Common mistakes

  • Thinking −7 is greater than −3 because 7 is greater than 3.
  • Losing a sign: 3 − (−5) = −2 instead of 8.
  • Moving left when adding a positive number.
